jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

jobs.title: Business Development Operation Intern
jobs.description_text: About this position We are looking for a Business Development Support Intern to work closely with the marketing team, managing and coordinating the BD team's schedule. The role involves using AI tools to clean leads, organize and update accounts, and provide data support to the sales team. This internship requires at least three days of attendance per week, with an immediate start date. If you have fluent English reading and writing skills and are curious about business development, we welcome you to join us.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Customer Success Manager at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok. You will work side by side with our HQ and APAC Customer Success Managers, supporting the day-to-day success of the Traffic Source Partners we onboard — affiliates, media partners, creator networks, and publishers who drive players to the web shops we operate for game developers. jobs.title: Dubai Events Community Manager, MENA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Dubai Events Community Manager who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate is a natural relationship-builder who thrives on turning event moments into lasting community connections across MENA's games industry, anchored by activity at the Xsolla Club in Dubai. You will use your community management, content, and relationship-building skills to grow and nurture Xsolla's network of partners, developers and clients in the region, working closely with the Dubai events team, Social Media Manager, and Marketing colleagues. The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering. Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd. Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. In al deze ontwerpen speelt brandveiligheid een cruciale rol. In de rol van adviseur opereer je op senior niveau en werk je aan complexe brandveiligheidsvraagstukken binnen al onze adviesgroepen: Gezondheidszor
